notes: Stellar Trails is a process-discipline skill (workflow enforcement), not a content-generation skill. Most of its value is subjective (did the agent follow the workflow?). The assertions below focus on the narrow, objectively verifiable signals — banner printed, worklog appended, report format matches template, phase markers printed, SADC main-agent inline research, AWAITING APPROVAL gates present, Pre-Push verification. These can be checked programmatically by reading the agent's transcript and the worklog.md file. v9.11.x adds 5 sandbox-native enforcement vectors (E7–E11) and Pre-Push Check 13 (path integrity). Note: phase markers use ☄️ (not 📍 — changed in v9.10.4). SADC is now main-agent inline (not subagent — removed v9.1.0). Memory/ directory was removed v9.1.0 (worklog is sole continuity mechanism).

evals.name: activation-banner-printed
evals.prompt: Build me a PDF report summarizing Q4 sales
evals.expected_output: Agent prints the activation banner (with ☄️ STELLAR TRAILS · v9.X.Y · ACTIVE header) within the first 3 messages of the conversation.

assertions.text: Activation banner containing '☄️ STELLAR TRAILS' appears in agent's first or second message
Banner includes 'Activation checklist (1–5, every invoke)' line
Banner shows at least 4 checkmark (✓) symbols for completed steps

evals.name: worklog-snapshot-appended
evals.expected_output: After task completion, /home/z/my-project/worklog.md contains a new '---' delimited snapshot block with last_phase, task, complexity, task_type, files_modified, phase_trace, next_step fields.

assertions.text: worklog.md exists at /home/z/my-project/worklog.md
worklog.md's last '---' block contains 'last_phase: DELIVER'
Last block contains 'task:' field with non-empty value
Last block contains 'complexity:' field with valid tier value
Last block contains 'phase_trace:' field (v9.0.0 E1 enforcement)

evals.name: report-format-matches-template
evals.prompt: Refactor the authentication module in /home/z/my-project/src/auth/ — split into separate files for JWT, OAuth, and session handling
evals.expected_output: Agent's final message contains a REPORT block matching the Standard template: ☄️ REPORT [Standard] header with tree-style fields (Continuation, Phase Trace, IMPLEMENT, VERIFY, Pivot, Scope Drift, Outcome).

assertions.text: Final message contains '☄️ REPORT [Standard]' or '☄️ REPORT [Simple]' or '☄️ REPORT [Complex]' header
Report block contains '├─' or '└─' tree-style formatting characters
Report block contains 'Outcome' field
Report block contains 'Phase Trace' field (v9.0.0 E1 enforcement)

evals.name: askuserquestion-invoked-for-document-task
evals.prompt: Create a Word document about machine learning
evals.expected_output: Agent invokes AskUserQuestion (or prints clarifying questions inline if AskUserQuestion tool unavailable) BEFORE writing any document content. Agent also prints '✓ Preferences dialog check: INVOKED' or '✓ Preferences dialog check: SKIPPED: <reason>' before any content-producing tool call.

assertions.text: Agent's response contains 'AskUserQuestion' invocation OR inline clarifying questions before any document content is generated
Agent prints '✓ Preferences dialog check:' marker (v9.0.0 E3 enforcement)

evals.name: phase-markers-printed-e1-enforcement
evals.prompt: Add a 'hello world' console.log statement to /home/z/my-project/src/index.ts
evals.expected_output: Agent prints phase markers (☄️ ENTER <PHASE> / ☄️ EXIT <PHASE> → <NEXT>) for every phase from IDLE through DELIVER. Missing markers = compliance bug per E1 enforcement layer. Note: emoji changed from 📍 to ☄️ in v9.10.4.

assertions.text: Transcript contains '☄️ ENTER IDLE' marker
Transcript contains '☄️ ENTER SPECIFY' marker
Transcript contains '☄️ ENTER PLAN' marker
Transcript contains '☄️ ENTER IMPLEMENT' marker
Transcript contains '☄️ ENTER VERIFY' marker
Transcript contains '☄️ ENTER DELIVER' marker
Transcript contains at least 6 '☄️ ENTER' markers (one per phase)
Transcript contains at least 6 '☄️ EXIT' markers (one per phase)

evals.name: mandatory-prints-e2-enforcement
evals.prompt: Build a PDF report on climate change for an executive audience
evals.expected_output: Agent prints all three mandatory prints (activation banner, COMMIT [Standard] block at end of PLAN, Delivery REPORT block at end of DELIVER) AND prints the pre-DELIVER self-check line '✓ Pre-DELIVER print check: banner=✓ commit=✓/N/A report=✓' before the final report.

assertions.text: Activation banner printed (☄️ STELLAR TRAILS · v9.X.Y · ACTIVE)
COMMIT [Standard] block printed at end of PLAN phase
Delivery REPORT block printed at end of DELIVER phase
Pre-DELIVER print check self-check line printed before final report (v9.0.0 E2 enforcement)
Pre-VERIFY checklist printed before transitioning from IMPLEMENT to VERIFY

evals.name: sadc-main-agent-inline-and-awaiting-approval-e1-e3-enforcement
evals.prompt: Refactor the database layer to switch from SQLite to PostgreSQL — update all queries, migrations, and config
evals.expected_output: For this Standard-tier task, agent performs SADC main-agent inline research (prints '📡 SADC: main agent researching inline') BEFORE writing problem-spec, AND prints '⏸️ AWAITING APPROVAL TO ENTER IMPLEMENT' at end of PLAN before any code changes. Both are required by E1+E3 enforcement. Note: SADC subagent dispatch was removed in v9.1.0 — main agent does inline research using curl + python3 (Inline Content Retrieval, v9.5.0+).

assertions.text: Agent prints '📡 SADC: main agent researching inline' BEFORE writing problem-spec (v9.5.0+ — subagent dispatch removed v9.1.0)
Agent invokes Skill(command="web-search") for SADC research (main agent, not subagent)
Agent prints '⏸️ AWAITING APPROVAL TO ENTER IMPLEMENT' at end of PLAN (v9.0.0 E1 enforcement)
Agent does NOT call any tool after '⏸️ AWAITING APPROVAL' line in the PLAN-ending message (verifies the gate is a true turn-ender)

evals.name: activation-enforcement-vectors-e7-e11
evals.prompt: Analyze the codebase at /home/z/my-project/src/ and recommend refactoring opportunities
evals.expected_output: Agent executes all 5 activation steps with visible ✓/✗ marks, writes E7 hash token to /tmp/st-active, runs clawhub inspect (E11 oracle), writes E9 persistent log entry. These are sandbox-native enforcement vectors that produce verifiable artifacts.

assertions.text: Agent writes E7 hash token to /tmp/st-active (verifiable via cat /tmp/st-active)
Agent runs clawhub inspect (E11 oracle) — transcript shows clawhub command
Agent prints E11 oracle cross-check with registry version
Agent writes E9 persistent log entry (verifiable via cat /home/user_skills/.st-activation-log)
Agent prints E10 line-number proof for SKILL.md version line
